Fisher Painting, Inc. is committed to delivering exceptional painting services at a fair price. Our mission is built on ensuring satisfaction for both our customers and employees, as we believe this is the foundation of our success. Honesty and integrity, in every aspect of our business, are at the core of the services we provide.

Our dedicated team consists of approximately 6 office staff and 75 skilled field employees, all working together to exceed your expectations.

item.dc:creator: ANNIEDAVIS523
item.content:encoded:
WELCOME TO

Fisher Painting

Fisher Painting, Inc. is dedicated in providing high-quality painting at a fair price. Satisfaction for both our employees and customers provide the backbone to achieve this goal. We believe that honesty in all aspects of the company and its employees, is the most critical factor in the services we provide.

We have been in business for 30+ years. Our services include Interior & Exterior paint, wall coverings, epoxy floor coatings, water repellents. We have a team of about 6 in office and 75 field employees.

Fisher Painting, Inc. is committed to delivering exceptional painting services at a fair price. Our mission is built on ensuring satisfaction for both our customers and employees, as we believe this is the foundation of our success. Honesty and integrity, in every aspect of our business, are at the core of the services we provide.

item.title: Services
item.dc:creator: ANNIEDAVIS523
item.content:encoded:
Interior Painting

Transform your space with Fisher Painting Services' expert interior painting solutions.

  • Tenant Improvements
  • Repaints
  • New Commercial
  • Residential
  • Multi-Family
View More

Exterior Coatings

Boost your property’s curb appeal and protect it from the elements with our specialized exterior painting services.

  • High Performance coatings
  • Water Repellents
  • Anti-graffiti coatings
  • Repaints
  • New Tilt-ups
  • Siding
  • Residential
View More

Plaster Coatings

Discover the timeless beauty and versatility of plaster coatings with Fisher Painting Services.

  • Gypsum based
  • Lime-based
  • Micro-cement
View More

Stain & Transparent Coatings

Enhance the natural beauty of your wood and other surfaces with our premium stain and transparent coating services.

  • Siding
  • Case, base, doors
  • CLT structure
View More

Wallcoverings

Transform your interiors with the sophisticated and dynamic wallcovering solutions from Fisher Painting Services.

  • Wallpapers
  • Standard commercial vinyl
  • Graphics & murals
  • Felt & acoustics
View More
